qualitative.gate_2_reason: Upstream seismic exploration and multi-client data licensing are highly discretionary and easily deferrable by E&P operators during downturns.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 2 (REJECT). Seismic exploration data licensing and speculative multi-client surveys are highly discretionary, deferrable capital expenditures that oil and gas operators cut drastically during industry downcycles.
qualitative.evidence: TGS operates multi-client seismic data libraries and acquisition vessels (following the PGS merger). Exploration spending is non-essential and volatile, subject to immediate cancellation or postponement during commodity price troughs, violating Gate 2 essential western need / entrenched habit standard.
